claims: Eid al-Fitr 2026 is expected to be celebrated on Friday, March 20, 2026, in Saudi Arabia and many parts of the world.
Eid al-Fitr 2026 is celebrated following the Ramadan moon sighting.
Some regions potentially observe Eid al-Fitr 2026 on March 21.
March 20, 2026, is the anticipated date for Eid al-Fitr 2026 in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and many Western nations.
Some regions, including parts of India, may observe Eid al-Fitr 2026 on March 21 due to different moon sighting reports.
Eid al-Fitr marks the end of the holy month of Ramadan.
Eid al-Fitr is known as the "Festival of Breaking the Fast".
Eid al-Fitr involves special morning prayers (Namaz).
Eid al-Adha is the second major Eid.
Eid al-Adha 2026 is anticipated to fall around May 26–27, 2026.
